Game Overview

Balloons puts players into a tap experience centered on pop balloons in a thrilling race against time. Wait for them to blink before you tap, but beware of sneaky bombs that can end your popping spree. How many will you burst in this fast-paced, reflex-testing adventure?

How to Play

Each session of Balloons follows a consistent rhythm. Pop balloons in a thrilling race against time! Wait for them to blink before you tap, but beware of sneaky bombs that can end your popping spree. How many will you burst in this fast-paced, reflex-testing adventure?
